description.message: Reopen closed tabs in one click. Browse and search recently closed tabs.

actionTitle.message: Reopen last closed tab · Right-click for history

intro.message: A second chance for the tabs you meant to keep.

pressHint.message: Click to reopen · Hold for history · Esc to hide the list

safariNotice.message: Safari records up to 100 closed web tabs locally after installation. Reopening restores the URL, not page state or back/forward history. Private and internal tabs are excluded.

privacy.message: On your device. No analytics, accounts or external requests.

stale.message: This tab is no longer available. Refresh the list.

loadError.message: Could not load closed tabs. Try again.
